items.label: Probe
items.hint: A survey probe to the surface.
items.why: It is on its way down.

items.label: Buoy
items.hint: A relay buoy over the mast. Enter arms it; hold Enter and it goes. It cannot be taken back.
items.why: Nothing below is marked for it yet: finish the scan.

effects.say: The buoy is out, and holding over the mast.

items.label: Drone
items.why: The drone needs the reactor steady.

effects.say: The drone unfolds and goes out along the hull.

items.hint: The tow drone, out along the hull.

items.label: Close
items.hint: Close the bay, and back to the bridge.
